_comment: Config-as-code startup profile for --engine tts. Startup precedence: CLI/env > this file > the clone's own fetched voice settings > registry defaults (knobs.py). 'Locking in' the CEO's ear-found config = editing voice_settings here and committing via PR — reviewable, no code edit. voice_settings is intentionally EMPTY for now so the clone's own settings remain the voice baseline until the drill fills it in; add fields (e.g. "stability": 0.5) to override. Eleven v3 ignores similarity_boost and use_speaker_boost. See SPIKE.md and agent/README.md.
